Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Modern Applications

Artificial intelligence has become a cornerstone of modern technology. From natural language
processing to computer vision, AI systems are transforming how we interact with the digital
world. Machine learning, a subset of AI, enables systems to learn patterns from data without
being explicitly programmed.

Deep learning, powered by neural networks with multiple layers, has achieved remarkable
results in various domains. Transformer architectures, introduced in the seminal paper
"Attention Is All You Need", have revolutionized natural language processing and beyond.

The development of large language models like GPT-4, Claude, and Llama has opened new
possibilities for text generation, summarization, and question answering. These models
are trained on vast amounts of text data and can perform a wide range of language tasks.

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines the power of large language models with
information retrieval systems. By grounding LLM responses in relevant documents, RAG
systems can provide more accurate and up-to-date information while reducing hallucinations.
